query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_outcomes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN gotReply = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as got_reply,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gotReply = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) as reply_rate_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN replySentiment = 'positive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_replies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN replySentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as negative_replies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN replySentiment = 'neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as neutral_replies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as won,
  SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'stale' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as stale,
  SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'dnc' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dnc
FROM message_outcomes 
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH);
